description: Journey vectors: a journey is one party's movement through dated events at their own places. The vectors pin the stop rules, the leg rules (an intended destination and a drift need their own claims; a leg is drawn only between located places and ends at their points).

vectors.why: A journey through two dated events at their own located places, with a schematic leg between them, is the ordinary case.
